title: Rabbi Abba bar Kahana bar Yudan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman records him only once, at the end of Shir HaShirim Rabbah chapter 7. Hyman says the name should actually read Rabbi Abba bar Yudan, as in Yalkut on Psalms, remez 717: Rav Kahana intruded from the preceding line.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ס״פז means the end of chapter 7 here, not section 87; תשיז is 717. The preceding-line intrusion is Hyman’s textual explanation.

The checked final paragraph of Shir HaShirim Rabbah chapter 7 has Abba bar Kahana followed by Abba bar Kahana bar Yudan. Yalkut on Psalms 717 has Abba bar Kahana followed by Abba bar Rabbi Yudan. This supports comparison of the two readings; Hyman’s “only once,” required correction and preceding-line intrusion remain his observation and explanation, without a fresh whole-corpus census or printed correction-history claim.
